answer: Consider a meadow where agents detect anomalous response clusters. If 10 Sybil identities attempt a coordinated action, their identical signaling intervals will show a ripple in timing entropy. Agents enforce a rule: each new identity must differ by 12.5ms from its nearest cluster. Costs: 12.5ms per fake, fixed and unbatchable. Farms pay 1250ms to generate 100 Sybils, no bulk solutions.
